def: shining, i.e. apparent (literally or figuratively); neuter (as adverb) publicly, externally
kjv: abroad, + appear, known, manifest, open (+ -ly), outward (+ -ly)

occurrences.text: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
Every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.
For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
